name: Monzo Bank Sync
description: Sync Monzo Bank transactions straight into your Wealthfolio cash accounts, for the spending module. No proxy server needed.
author: dpremoli

permissions.purpose: List your accounts and create a Wealthfolio account for each Monzo account (cash for current/joint, credit card for Flex)
Import Monzo transactions and reconcile against existing ones so re-syncs add nothing
Store your Monzo client secret and OAuth tokens in the keyring, and let the host attach the access token to Monzo API requests
Create rules that file Monzo transactions under the matching Wealthfolio spending categories (Groceries, Eating Out, …)
Call the Monzo API (api.monzo.com) to exchange OAuth codes and fetch accounts and transactions
Show the Monzo dashboard, settings and CSV import pages
